text: Think about a recipe card: once you have a good recipe, you don't reinvent the steps every time you cook.
A skill is a recipe card for Claude.
While a prompt is typed for a one-time request, a skill is a saved, reusable method that defines steps, templates, tone, and a final checklist.
Skills also keep your context desk clean: Claude sees only a short summary of each skill, loading the full instructions only when needed for the task.
Whenever you find yourself repeating instructions, or when a workflow needs a consistent team standard, turn that method into a reusable skill.
